title: C. C. Augur (Department of Texas) to Sheridan and Russell, four route-cipher telegrams, 9-17 Jan 1874 (Newberry, Ayer MS 3008 box 02)

steps.what: Lead from the Chicago Collections sweep: Newberry Transcribe volunteer text of Augur letter-book p. 85 with three scrambled-word telegrams; scan viewed in Newberry Digital Collections.
Read the 1869 Fifth Military District letter in the Grierson papers (Newberry Transcribe, 3 pages): it explains the route system by a worked example, not Augur's tables.
Checked the volunteer transcription of pp. 84-85 against the scans and corrected it (table, Nueces, I. Davis, to, late, and).
DP over column order and direction scored with the letter 5-gram en-modern model; failed to recover even the 1869 worked example.
Word-bigram model from en-gutenberg plus the DP recovered the 1869 example's 5-column structure and row text.
Telegram 45: rows of 7, columns read as English phrases; DP gave the route 1d 7u 4d 6u 2d 5u 3d with three fillers.
Telegram 30 read with the route of 45 unchanged.
Scored all 842 transcribed Augur pages with the bigram model to find more cipher; found telegram 22 on p. 84.
Telegram 22: indicator Baltic outside the grid, 9 columns all down in the order 2,4,6,8,9,7,5,3,1.
Telegram 29: Dresden as indicator and I. I. as two words give 7 x 7; route 1d 7u 6u 2d 5u 4d 3d; seven arbitraries stay open.
Web searches for the telegram wording and Davis's dispatch: nothing published found.
Readings agree with the dated events of the Davis-Coke dispute (court ruling, legislature meeting Tuesday 13 Jan, Grant's refusal of troops).

validation.notes: word route transposition: the plaintext words are the cipher words, so there is no token-wise substitution key to test against chance

outcome.method_basis: The four routes were recovered from the cipher words alone with a word-bigram model; the 1869 key letter gave only the general method, and none of its tables or arbitraries were used.
outcome.fraction_read_source: route.py over ct_22/29/30/45.txt: 244 grid words (indicators excluded), 237 with a reading including 7 fillers; 7 arbitraries in telegram 29 open.

gaps.item: telegram 29, arbitraries nun, scatter, faint, table, novel, fussy, self
gaps.detail: the Department of Texas list of arbitraries is not in the Augur or Grierson papers, and each word occurs once

texts.label: Telegram 22, Augur to Sheridan, 9 Jan 1874
texts.summary: Augur reports that the Texas Supreme Court has ruled the election law unconstitutional and that Governor Davis, expecting the newly elected legislature and governor to seize the government by force, asks for U.S. troops; Augur declines to act without the President's orders and asks Sheridan whether he is right.

reading_review.note: Reads as continuous English; 'precedent' is the clerk's slip for President and 'the asks' probably for 'He asks'.

texts.label: Telegram 29, Augur to Sheridan, 12 Jan 1874
texts.summary: Augur forwards a dispatch from Davis for President Grant warning that unauthorized persons may try to take the state buildings; seven code words are open.

reading_review.note: Sentences hold around seven single code words (nun, scatter, faint, table, novel, fussy, self); the closing clause is uncertain.

texts.label: Telegram 30, Augur to Russell, 12 Jan 1874
texts.summary: Augur tells Major Russell in Austin that, through Sheridan, the President has no instructions to give, and that he has sent on the Governor's dispatch.

reading_review.note: Reads at once; 'In' and 'though' are copying slips for 'I' and 'through'.

texts.label: Telegram 45, Augur to Russell, 17 Jan 1874
texts.summary: Augur tells Russell that if Davis yields to force without armed collision that is all that can be expected, that neither the President nor the party wants trouble, that he need not recognize either governor, and that Sellers is not to interfere without orders.

outcome.notes: Transposition with whole words: no substitution key to test token by token.

prior.where: No decipherment in the letter-book; web searches for the wording (29 Oct 2026) found nothing; Sheridan's received copies (Division of the Missouri records) not checked.

human: Project-level: asked for a sweep of Chicago archives and then for an attempt on this lead; passed a Cloudflare check in Chrome for the finding-aid searches. No target-specific intervention.
